summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 21 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: China Uses Dual-Method Cyberattack on Czech Orgs
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 62 articles published in the last 24 hours
